notes: Self-contained single-file HTML app. Each cycle is one entry in the CYCLES registry inside blaze-app.html. The bottom-nav hamburger (and the header chip) open the cycle switcher. Archived pristine copies live in ./archive/.

cycles.name: Arm & Bicep
cycles.subtitle: 8-Week Heavy Linear
cycles.focus: Bench + arm size · post-surgery return · spine-friendly
cycles.split: PPL — Push · Legs · Pull · Legs² · Push² (5x/week)
cycles.note: First cycle. User reports this worked well for arms.

cycles.name: Shoulder & Delt
cycles.subtitle: 5-Week Rear-Delt Block
cycles.focus: Rear-delt-first · 3D delts · seated press anchor · spine-friendly
cycles.split: 5-day upper/lower alternating — Mon Press · Tue Lower A · Wed Rear · Thu Lower B · Fri Volume
cycles.note: Draft v2 (2026-07-25), revised per Jason's feedback: (1) NO pec-deck / reverse pec-deck and NO cable rear-delt cross - gym doesn't have them; rear delts run on chest-supported DB flyes, flared high rows, rope face pulls, band pull-aparts. (2) Biceps reduced to ONE heavy day (Wed) + one optional light day (Fri) - was 3 consecutive days, too much elbow volume. (3) Press variety: main anchor rotates in 2-week waves (A=Seated Neutral-Grip DB, B=Seated Landmine, Wk5 back to A to measure the PR) with % climbing weekly for linear progression; Friday uses a different angle (high-incline DB); laterals and rear flyes rotate weekly. (4) NEVER two upper days back to back - lower/abs day always between. Rear delts still lead (~20 sets/wk, trained every upper day).
